verdict.rationale: Mocking is a fair question for an API gateway and API management platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a mock server generated from saved examples or an OpenAPI spec. The closest items are Dev Portal publishing OpenAPI specs and letting developers try API operations, which is an adjacent documentation feature, not mocking.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up a mock server from saved examples or a spec so consumers can build before the API exists
